text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Cross-region routing anomaly detected — elevated tail latency for eu-west -> api-tier (alerts triggered). Pager duty: oncall shift page sent to @Maya.
Maya Patel: seeing a bunch of 500s + p99 spiking for eu-west clients. Metrics show a sudden shift to us-east backends for ~12% of requests.
Alex Chen: confirmed — flow logs show requests from eu-west going to us-east-1 pool. That's wrong, should be honoring region-pin policy.
Maya Patel: did anyone touch routing policies in last 30m?
Liam O'Connor: I deployed a small change to regional pin evaluation 22m ago — it was a tweak to fallback ordering (PR #4782).
Sasha Ivanov: that PR added a new fallback 'prefer-cost' path, I reviewed but didn't expect cross-region pins to be affected.
Alex Chen: logs show policy resolution returning fallback candidate set that includes us-east for eu-west pins. looks like the pin matching predicate returned false for some requests.
Maya Patel: impact: degraded latency for eu-west customers using pinned routes -> some errors from downstream timeouts. Customer Success Bot: flagged 4 high-revenue accounts experiencing 30-60s tails.
Maya Patel: paging oncall; @Liam you oncall?
Liam O'Connor: I'm oncall now, joining. Looking at the PR diff — I see an edge case where pin expiry logic uses `Math.floor(now / 1000)` vs `now` in ms. Could be off by factor 1000 in some lookups.
Alex Chen: that would make recent pins look expired -> route resolution falls back. matches the timing.
Maya Patel: timeline: PR deployed 22m ago, errors start ~20m ago. plausible.
incident-bot: Deploy 4782 rolled at 2025-11-07T12:03:40Z by liam.
Sasha Ivanov: can we hotfix? Option A: rollback PR 4782 to restore previous logic. Option B: patch the expiry calculation and redeploy. Rollback is fastest.
Liam O'Connor: rolling back now. Triggering rollback to deploy-4779.
oncall-ops-bot: rollback started: deploy-4779 restoring routing-eval at 2025-11-07T12:27:05Z.
Alex Chen: while rollback runs, temp mitigation: add an emergency routing override on control-plane to force eu-west pins to prefer local pool. I'll add a pinned rule with TTL 30m.
Sasha Ivanov: please add note in console so operators know it's a manual override.
Alex Chen: added rule: `region_override: { from: eu-west, to: eu-west, reason: "emergency pin fallback" }`, TTL 1800s.
Maya Patel: any immediate change in traffic?
Liam O'Connor: rollback finished. Deploy health checks passing.
oncall-ops-bot: rollback completed: deploy-4779 at 2025-11-07T12:31:10Z.
Alex Chen: I'm seeing traffic shift back to eu-west pools. error rate dropping. p99 tail improving.
Sasha Ivanov: confirm KV entries for pins — some entries had expiry in seconds not ms; patch in PR will fix it but rollback should stop new incidents.
Maya Patel: great. action items: 1) Liam to open hotfix PR that fixes expiry units + add unit tests (ETA 1h). 2) Sasha to run a canary for patch before rolling (ETA 30m). 3) Alex to remove emergency override after 30m if metrics stable. 4) Ops to draft post-incident customer brief.
Liam O'Connor: making the PR now (hotfix/expiry-units). will include regression test for both seconds and ms inputs.
Alex Chen: monitoring dashboard: p50/p95/p99 and cross-region rate. I'll keep a watch for next 45m.
Customer Success Bot: Notified account reps for affected customers with preliminary summary.
Maya Patel: classification: Sev2 (partial outage for subset of traffic -> major customer impact).
Sasha Ivanov: root cause: incorrect time unit handling in pin expiry evaluation introduced by PR #4782 -> pins appeared expired -> fallback selected cross-region fallback causing increased latency and downstream timeouts.
Liam O'Connor: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4892 (hotfix).
Maya Patel: postmortem owners assigned: Liam (code fix), Alex (mitigation & rollback play), Sasha (tests + canary). I'll schedule follow-up with CS for external comms.
Maya Patel: any remaining risks?
Alex Chen: we should audit other places where expiry is read/written — might be inconsistent across older code. I'll add a quick grep + audit ticket.
Sasha Ivanov: will add an integration test harness to simulate pin expiry cross-timeunit boundary.
incident-bot: Incident closed to on-call after rollback and mitigation. Metrics stable for 20m.
Maya Patel: thanks team. I'll write the incident summary and populate the timeline. :white_check_mark:
